package helper

import "time"

func Clean()                    {}
func Dirty()                    { _ = time.Now() }
func Set(p *func())             { *p = Dirty }
func Iter(yield func(int) bool) { _ = time.Now(); yield(1) }

type Value struct{}

func (*Value) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { _ = time.Now(); return []byte("null"), nil }
